title: Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program: Counting Day of a Weekend Withdrawal Notice
content:
**Rule.** Under the Creek Kids Club Extended Day Program, the notice period of a withdrawal notice is counted in calendar days from the notice's counting day as day 0. The counting day is set by the day of the week on which the notice was received:

| Notice received on | Counting day (day 0) |
|---|---|
| a Saturday | 2 days later, the following Monday |
| a Sunday | 1 day later, the following Monday |
| a weekday, Monday through Friday | the day it was received |

## Examples (hypothetical calendar in which the 5th is a Saturday)

| Notice received | Counting day | Day 7 of the notice period |
|---|---|---|
| Saturday the 5th | Monday the 7th | Monday the 14th |
| Sunday the 6th | Monday the 7th | Monday the 14th |
| Friday the 4th | Friday the 4th | Friday the 11th |
| Monday the 7th | Monday the 7th | Monday the 14th |

The day of receipt is the date on the withdrawal notice request.
